prompt:
Create a striking high-contrast black-and-white typographic fashion portrait designed as an intricate editorial text-mosaic artwork, with one selective color accent. Vertical 9:16 canvas. Show a young woman with pale skin, round wire-frame glasses, full red lips, and dark messy hair in a high bun with loose strands from roughly mid-torso upward, facing forward in a graceful fashion pose with a calm, confident expression. She wears a dark turtleneck under a textured oversized coat. Build her face, hair, neck, coat, and clothing shadows from dense layers of tiny black typography, newspaper fragments, handwritten script, typewriter letters, and microtext, creating realistic facial structure and fabric texture through text density rather than smooth shading. Keep the image mostly monochrome: off-white paper background, black ink portrait, grey text texture, and only the lips in muted glossy red. Add black ink splatters, distressed grunge speckles, scattered floating letters, and torn editorial typography around the figure.

Place a bold vertical cluster of large white words embedded in the dark hair area on the upper left, containing exactly 10 visible labels: ENERGY, BILLS, MONEY, SCHOOL, DEADLINES, STRESSES, PROJECTS, OBLIGATIONS, FAILURES, FEARS. On the chest and scarf area, place a strong motivational word collage with exactly 22 visible labels: SUCCESS as the largest central word, plus FOCUS, DISCIPLINE, AMBITION, GRIND, GOALS, DEDICATION, CONSISTENCY, PERSISTENCE, HUSTLE, FAITH, HOPE, STRENGTH, COURAGE, PATIENCE, PURPOSE, PASSION, DREAMS, FUTURE, POSITIVITY, LIFE, and CHANGE. Use dramatic magazine-cover typography with mixed serif capitals, varied font sizes, warped perspective, and tightly packed micro-letters. Background should resemble an aged manuscript page filled with faint cursive writing and faded editorial text blocks, including subtle hints of newspaper headings such as PARIS. Preserve a handmade ink-and-paper look with high detail, gritty edges, asymmetrical splatter distribution, and no clean digital gradients. Avoid additional people, avoid bright colors except the red lips, and do not add a logo or watermark.

promptZh:
创作一张引人注目的高对比度黑白排版时尚肖像，主体为 一位留着凌乱深色高丸子头、脸颊两侧有碎发、戴圆框眼镜、涂着微红亮面唇釉的年轻女性，设计成复杂的编辑风格文字马赛克艺术品。使用 9:16 的竖向画布。展示她从腰部/胸部向上，正面对镜头，表情冷静严肃，头部微倾，身穿深色高领毛衣和质感超大款外套或西装。用成千上万个微小的黑色字母、单词、报纸碎片和密集的微排版构建出她的面部、头发、眼镜、颈部、外套和阴影，同时保持逼真的面部比例和可辨识的时尚肖像光影。让嘴唇成为唯一的强色彩点缀：柔和的深红色，光泽且逼真。

在头发左上方放置一个醒目的排版块，包含 8 个堆叠的大号压力相关词汇：ENERGY、BILLS、MONEY、SCHOOL、DEADLINES、STRESSES、PROJECTS、GOALS。用较小的填充词和粗犷的墨迹飞溅环绕该区域。在下半身和围巾/高领毛衣区域，整合 20 个醒目的粗体衬线排版励志词汇，其中 SUCCESS 为最大的中心词：FOCUS、DISCIPLINE、SUCCESS、AMBITION、GRIND、GOALS、DEDICATION、CONSISTENCY、PERSISTENCE、HUSTLE、FAITH、HOPE、STRENGTH、COURAGE、PATIENCE、PURPOSE、PASSION、DREAMS、FUTURE、POSITIVITY、LIFE。使用不同的比例、曲率和图层，使文字顺应衣物的褶皱。

背景：米白色陈旧纸张，上面布满模糊的手写草书笔记、淡色的报纸段落、细微的图表以及散落漂浮的黑色字母。添加黑色墨水溅痕、污迹、斑点、磨损的半色调纹理、撕裂的边缘以及在肖像周围漂浮的随机字母，特别是在左侧和下边缘。风格应融合奢侈时尚杂志封面、哥特式报纸拼贴、表现力书法和垃圾摇滚海报艺术。使用强对比度、精细的线条、清晰易读的标题词、密集的微文字纹理，避免干净的数字矢量感。避免出现其他人、现代 UI 元素、标志或水印。
